_doc: Cube colors and stacking rules for the diverse OCBench cube-stacking set (block-double-task2). Each episode gets one allowed (top, bottom) pair, sampled uniformly. 'fixed': only this order is ever shown. 'never': the two colors never appear in the same scene. 'free': both orders appear. Prompt: 'stack the <top> cube on top of the <bottom> cube'.
prompt: stack the {top} cube on top of the {bottom} cube
